lines: Sandeep Sambhaji Parab, Other Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 2,136,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹70.49 crore are scheduled on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares, valued at ₹81.07 crore (estimate) at offer price, are locked for 6 months from allotment, so more value follows later.
Gain is unknown: average cost of acquisition is not confirmed from the documents.
